pages.title: Pre-admission procedure plan
lines: Date: 10/02/2026   Pt: Whitcombe, Dale R   Proc: transvenous single-chamber ICD (CPT 33249)
Indication: ischemic CM, LVEF 30% (TTE 10/01/26), NYHA II, on GDMT, SDM completed 09/29.
Interval hx: no chest pain or ACS since index NSTEMI of 08/27/26. No revascularization done or planned.

Rationale: (1) uninterrupted DAPT w/ ticagrelor + ASA <6 wks from ACS, high pocket hematoma risk, needs serial pocket checks and compression; (2) CKD 3b, eGFR 38, renal fxn and K check POD1; (3) insulin-requiring DM2 w/ A1c 8.4, needs inpatient insulin titration around NPO period.

Screening for contraindications: alert, oriented, manages own meds, no cognitive impairment. No malignancy or other illness limiting survival to <1 yr. No AF history, SR on all ECGs. Euvolemic, BP stable on oral regimen, clinically stable for elective implant.

comorbidities.why: Pre-admission plan lists DAPT bleeding risk, CKD 3b and insulin-requiring DM2 as the LOS rationale; HTN is in the EP consult on page 2.

lvef_percent.why: TTE 08/28/2026 (pages 2 and 3) shows 25%; TTE 10/01/2026 (page 4) shows 30%. The later measurement wins.

nyha_class.why: EP consult assessment: 'NYHA class II'; repeated on page 8.

cardiomyopathy_type.why: Ischemic cardiomyopathy after NSTEMI with severe 3-vessel CAD.

recent_mi_revasc.why: NSTEMI on 2026-08-27 is 41 days before the planned implant on 2026-10-07, so it is outside the 40-day window (it is only 38 days before today, which is the trap). No PCI was done and CABG was not offered; no prior PCI or CABG.

optimal_medical_therapy_months.why: All four HF GDMT drugs started 2026-08-30. That is 38 days (1.2 months) to the planned implant. Rule 6 applies only to non-ischemic cardiomyopathy, so this short duration does not block approval.

shared_decision_making.why: Formal SDM visit on 2026-09-29 with an evidence-based ICD decision aid, before the implant.

limiting_conditions.why: Plan explicitly screens out cognitive impairment, illness limiting survival to under 1 year, and AF, and states he is clinically stable.

action_reasoning: Rule 1: ischemic. Rule 2: LVEF 30% (latest). Rule 3: echo. Rule 4: NYHA II. Rule 5: MI 41 days before implant, outside 40 days; no revascularization. Rule 6: not applicable (ischemic). Rule 7: SDM with decision aid 09/29. Rule 8: none. Rule 9: 2 midnights with documented DAPT, CKD and insulin factors. All met, so approve.
